`GET /user/ssh_signing_keys` · operationId `users/list-ssh-signing-keys-for-authenticated-user` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/ssh-signing-keys#list-ssh-signing-keys-for-the-authenticated-user)

- Paging: page-based (`page`, `per_page`); items: the response body is the array; `Link` header
- Responses: `200`: application/json array of `ssh-signing-key` (headers: `Link`) · `304` · `401`: application/json `basic-error` · `403`: application/json `basic-error` · `404`: application/json `basic-error`
- Notes: not available to GitHub App installation tokens

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `per_page` | query | integer |  | `30` |  |
| `page` | query | integer |  | `1` |  |

### Create a SSH signing key for the authenticated user

`POST /user/ssh_signing_keys` · operationId `users/create-ssh-signing-key-for-authenticated-user` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/ssh-signing-keys#create-a-ssh-signing-key-for-the-authenticated-user)

- Responses: `201`: application/json `ssh-signing-key` · `304` · `401`: application/json `basic-error` · `403`: application/json `basic-error` · `404`: application/json `basic-error` · `422`: application/json `validation-error`
- Notes: not available to GitHub App installation tokens

Request body (`application/json`, required): object

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string |  |  |  |
| `key` | string | yes |  | pattern `^ssh-(rsa\|dss\|ed25519) \|^ecdsa-sha2-nistp(256\|384\|521) \|^(sk-ssh-ed25519\|sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256)@openssh.com ` |

### Get an SSH signing key for the authenticated user

`GET /user/ssh_signing_keys/{ssh_signing_key_id}` · operationId `users/get-ssh-signing-key-for-authenticated-user` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/ssh-signing-keys#get-an-ssh-signing-key-for-the-authenticated-user)

- Responses: `200`: application/json `ssh-signing-key` · `304` · `401`: application/json `basic-error` · `403`: application/json `basic-error` · `404`: application/json `basic-error`
- Notes: not available to GitHub App installation tokens

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ssh_signing_key_id` | path | integer | yes |  |  |

### Delete an SSH signing key for the authenticated user

`DELETE /user/ssh_signing_keys/{ssh_signing_key_id}` · operationId `users/delete-ssh-signing-key-for-authenticated-user` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/ssh-signing-keys#delete-an-ssh-signing-key-for-the-authenticated-user)

- Responses: `204` · `304` · `401`: application/json `basic-error` · `403`: application/json `basic-error` · `404`: application/json `basic-error`
- Notes: not available to GitHub App installation tokens

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ssh_signing_key_id` | path | integer | yes |  |  |

### List SSH signing keys for a user

`GET /users/{username}/ssh_signing_keys` · operationId `users/list-ssh-signing-keys-for-user` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/ssh-signing-keys#list-ssh-signing-keys-for-a-user)

- Paging: page-based (`page`, `per_page`); items: the response body is the array; `Link` header
- Responses: `200`: application/json array of `ssh-signing-key` (headers: `Link`)

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `per_page` | query | integer |  | `30` |  |
| `page` | query | integer |  | `1` |  |

## users

### Get the authenticated user

`GET /user` · operationId `users/get-authenticated` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/users#get-the-authenticated-user)

- Responses: `200`: application/json `private-user` | `public-user` · `304` · `401`: application/json `basic-error` · `403`: application/json `basic-error`
- Notes: not available to GitHub App installation tokens

### Update the authenticated user

`PATCH /user` · operationId `users/update-authenticated` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/users#update-the-authenticated-user)

- Responses: `200`: application/json `private-user` · `304` · `401`: application/json `basic-error` · `403`: application/json `basic-error` · `404`: application/json `basic-error` · `422`: application/json `validation-error`
- Notes: not available to GitHub App installation tokens

Request body (`application/json`, optional): object

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |  |  |
| `email` | string |  |  |  |
| `blog` | string |  |  |  |
| `twitter_username` | string \| null |  |  |  |
| `company` | string |  |  |  |
| `location` | string |  |  |  |
| `hireable` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `bio` | string |  |  |  |

### Get a user using their ID

`GET /user/{account_id}` · operationId `users/get-by-id` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/users#get-a-user-using-their-id)

- Responses: `200`: application/json `private-user` | `public-user` · `404`: application/json `basic-error`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | path | integer | yes |  |  |

### List users

`GET /users` · operationId `users/list` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/users#list-users)

- Paging: `per_page`; items: the response body is the array; `Link` header
- Responses: `200`: application/json array of `simple-user` (headers: `Link`) · `304`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | query | integer |  |  |  |
| `per_page` | query | integer |  | `30` |  |

### Get a user

`GET /users/{username}` · operationId `users/get-by-username` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/users#get-a-user)

- Responses: `200`: application/json `private-user` | `public-user` · `404`: application/json `basic-error`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | path | string | yes |  |  |

### Get contextual information for a user

`GET /users/{username}/hovercard` · operationId `users/get-context-for-user` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/users/users#get-contextual-information-for-a-user)

- Responses: `200`: application/json `hovercard` · `404`: application/json `basic-error` · `422`: application/json `validation-error`
- Notes: not available to GitHub App installation tokens

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `subject_type` | query | string |  |  | one of: `organization`, `repository`, `issue`, `pull_request` |
| `subject_id` | query | string |  |  |  |
